title: Preserved work (prior snapshots) is invisible across run ids, exactly as the reports were
body: priorSnapshots walks the same <ExecStateRoot>/<runID>/<tick>/<n> layout the reports' discovery did before n4h, so a re-run under a new run id is never pointed at a previous run's preserved wip refs. The nvn-to-n4h shape is now proven twice: the same cross-run walk, the same tick-keyed record check (fileWIPSnapshot beside an attempt.json naming the tick), applied to work instead of analysis.
